entries.classification: Separate ≤ from the middleCapacity identifier and make an already proved local positivity fact available before its use

changes.before:
obtain ⟨hprod,hleft,hright⟩ := actualTwoCapacityFactors_correct hA hC [slots t 1] hs
  have hdQ := (rational_parameters B hvalid hpositive htest).2.2.1
  have hd : (0:ℝ)<(delta B:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdQ
changes.after: obtain ⟨hprod,hleft,hright⟩ := actualTwoCapacityFactors_correct hA hC [slots t 1] hs

rw [U1011OriginalW16NativeInitialization.W_cap] at hcap
  have hdQ := (rational_parameters B hvalid hpositive htest).2.2.1
  have hd : (0:ℝ)<(delta B:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdQ

entries.statement_change_note: The observed pinned parser consumed ≤m as Matroid notation and left auto-implicit iddleCapacity; the original declaration was not accepted. Spaces separate the intended order relation and the original middleCapacity constant. No equivalence of previously accepted elaborated types is claimed.
entries.mathematical_note: The positive delta fact is already present verbatim later in this same proof, derived from rational_parameters with the same B, eta (where applicable), validity, positivity and whole-box certificate. Move those two original have declarations before hnu so linarith can use 0 < delta together with hcap and the existing nonnegative coordinate. No positivity premise, theorem, coefficient or bound is added. NearCapSupport is an exact same-pattern follow-up in the 377-module closure, not a separate direct failure.
